summary: The change adds a fail-closed check in validate() (src/engine/hand.ts) that rejects configs whose seat stacks total more than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and rewords two comments. Trust boundary: the HandConfig passed to createHand, which will include restored session data in TASK-3.10. createHand copies the config into a snapshot (primitives copied, deck spread) before validate runs and then uses only the snapshot, so getters or mutation cannot switch values between check and use. The sum check is sound in floating point: it runs only after every stack is confirmed to be a positive safe integer, so the partial sums only grow, rounding preserves order, and 2^53 is exactly representable. A true total above MAX_SAFE_INTEGER therefore always gives a float sum of at least 2^53, so the check cannot be evaded by rounding down to MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Because chips are conserved, the check bounds every later stack, contribution, pot and award. Error messages echo only values already validated (seat number, min) or a constant. No new dependencies, randomness, I/O, secrets, or injection sinks. No findings.
